caption:
Day one's page beside today's

She pulled the first page out from under today's. One tick then, four now.

The first page proves you moved, even when every day feels the same.

For whoever looks back at day one on the days it feels slow.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a paper page titled Today with four ticked boxes lies on top of an older page. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the older page, titled Day 1 with one tick, slides out to the left and stops beside Today, with a small sparkle over Today. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: I haven't improved at all, to: day one had one tick.
